resources.string: Daily backup was enabled, but its previous account cannot be identified. Turn on the switch to authorize it for the connected account.
Your backup is saved. Older backups could not be removed; maintenance will retry with the next backup.
Recovered the upload of %1$s. It keeps its original date; create another backup to include later changes.

Restoring will remove %1$d expense rows and %2$d income rows from the linked workbook. Personal columns and all Drive documents are kept. Changes remain queued until this account and workbook are available.
No local recovery copies are available for this workbook yet.
Restore %1$d rows and remove %2$d rows managed by FinAI. Personal sheets, columns, notes, filters and charts are kept. App data is unchanged.
Automatic sync is paused for this workbook. “Sync changes” will send the current app data again.
Recovery copy restored in the same workbook. Automatic sync is paused.
The workbook changed after the preview. Close this dialog and select the copy again.
This recovery copy is unavailable or incompatible with the current workbook.
Could not refresh the list. The backup creation result is unchanged.
A verified local recovery copy will be saved before updating FinAI-managed areas with current app data. The workbook and personal columns and sheets are kept.
This phone becomes the only FinAI writer for the linked workbook. The next sync uses its local data; other phones will stop writing.
Another phone manages this workbook. Transfer sync ownership in advanced options.
The workbook uses an unrecognized version. Update FinAI before continuing.
The workbook contains ambiguous columns or document identities. Data was preserved for review.
The recovery copy could not be verified. The workbook was not changed.
Workbook creation is awaiting confirmation. Sync again when connected; another workbook will not be created.
The linked workbook is unavailable. Check the account, permission and link.
The workbook is in Drive trash. Restore it to keep the same link.
Connect the Google account linked to the workbook and grant the required permissions.
Could not connect to Google. Changes remain pending and can be retried.
Sync did not complete. Local data is kept; try again.
